SHORT
Open your own Liquor Store!
LONG
Liquor Store Simulator is a simulation game about developing your own store. You start your business in a small shop that you bought on credit.<br/><br/>Buy goods, manage your store, hire staff. Who knows, maybe you will be able to make a real alcohol empire out of a small store.<br/><br/>At first, it won’t be easy—you’ll have to work at the checkout yourself, accept deliveries, keep records, and maintain order in the sales area. But hard work and smart decisions will help you turn a modest retail outlet into a thriving store with a wide selection and satisfied customers.<br/><br/>Management<br/>Purchase goods, arrange retail equipment as you see fit.<br/><br/>Draft Beer<br/>Feel like a bartender. Pour customers the beer they desire.<br/><br/>Staff Management<br/>At first, you’ll have to do everything yourself. But as your store grows, you won’t be able to handle it alone. Hire employees for efficient store management.<br/><br/>Customization<br/>Change the color of walls, ceilings, and floors. Make your store unique and unlike any other.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>1 players

LONG
Explore Olathe and unmask its twisted secrets with LISA: The Definitive Edition, including the original narrative-driven RPG LISA: The Painful and its sequel LISA: The Joyful.<br/><br/>LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition is the miserable, hilarious RPG of your wildest nightmares. Undertake a relentless journey through the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Olathe. Beneath its charming exterior is a world full of disgust and moral desolation, where you will learn what kind of person you are by being FORCED to make choices that permanently affect the gameplay. Make sacrifices to keep your party members alive, whether it's taking a beating for them, losing limbs, or some other inhuman torture. In this world, you will learn that being selfish and heartless is the only way to survive...<br/><br/>LISA: The Joyful - Definitive Edition is the soul-twisting conclusion to the quirky side-scrolling RPG series, LISA. Explore Olathe in your quest to punish the world that has treated you wrong. Along the way, learn about this strange land, your family, and the monsters/men in power. The world’s out to get you… now, get it back.<br/>

SHORT
Discover a modernized remake of the cult action-adventure game
LONG
Step into Twinsun's fantastical world in this action-adventure remake! Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest brings brand new visuals, new music by the original composer, and smoother gameplay to the iconic classic released back in 1994.<br/><br/>Embark on a Timeless Adventure, Reimagined<br/>Twinsen is back in this remake featuring a new stylish makeover and modernized gameplay. Faithful to the original game, Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest takes you on an epic journey on a small planet harboring both magic and technology.<br/><br/>A Tale of Destiny and Heroism<br/>On a planetoid with two suns, four species lived in perfect harmony... But that all changed when the brilliant scientist Dr. FunFrock invented cloning and teleportation, bringing the inhabitants under his total control. End the clone occupation while playing as Twinsen, a model citizen turned fugitive. Armed with your mysterious Magic Ball, explore beautiful landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and face formidable foes!<br/><br/>Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the series, Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest offers an adventure like no other. Are you ready to become the hero Twinsun needs?<br/><br/>FEATURES<br/>• Discover a compelling story with deep themes.<br/>• Navigate through Twinsun with a revamped level layout and redesigned controls.<br/>• Defeat foes with an enhanced Magic Ball.<br/>• Enjoy a brand new artistic direction.<br/>• Immerse yourself with a new soundtrack by the original composer.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>Vibration function and trigger effect supported (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players

ARE YOU MORE AFRAID OF POVERTY THAN DEATH?<br><br>If you grew up in the 1980s and 1990s, you may have been shielded from the full weight of existence by a happy and prosperous middle-class family, as well as access to an education which seemed to imply that your own life would be similarly rich with possibility.<br><br>Little Red Lie is a narrative-focused, interactive fiction experience that reduces the traditional nine-verb adventure game structure down to a single, context-dependent interaction: LIE.<br><br>If you enjoy realistic and dramatic stories in a contemporary setting which deal with weighty issues of family, society and politics, Little Red Lie will offer a unique perspective into the subtle (and not-so-subtle) deceptions that shape our daily lives.<br><br>This Cross-Buy product entitles you to download both PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®Vita versions.<br><br>This product supports the following languages: English<br><br>1 player<br>HD Video Output 720p,1080i,1080p<br><br>Download of this product is subject to the PlayStation Network Terms of Service and our Software Usage Terms plus any specific additional conditions applying to this product. LONG
Play as a small creature named Whys on a journey to find the love of its life, Kys, who has been lost deep within the dungeons. Harness the power of colors to solve puzzles, unlock new abilities, and platform your way to freedom. Jump, dash, and even manipulate gravity itself to overcome every obstacle.<br/><br/>Interact with your surroundings and use your agility to complete levels as quickly as possible and earn satisfying bonuses.<br/><br/>With over 80 levels of challenge and fun, your skills will be constantly put to the test. Precise controls deliver a smooth yet demanding experience, rewarding mastery and quick thinking.<br/><br/>Designed with a gentle learning curve, the game quickly pushes you to improve and refine your abilities.<br/><br/>Die. Retry. Adapt. Conquer the dungeons through skill, persistence, and sheer determination.<br/><br/>Features:<br/>- Color-Based Gameplay: Switch colors to unlock unique abilities and change how you approach every challenge<br/>-  Fast & Precise Controls: Tight movement and instant retries keep the action fluid and addictive<br/>- Dynamic Level Design: Each level introduces new twists, mechanics, and ways to interact with the environment<br/>- 80 Challenging Levels: Test your skills, improve your timing, and master every obstacle<br/>

SHORT
Light, darkness and remarkable puzzles!
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Set in an era when electricity wasn’t a thing and nothing but imaginations of great inventors that set the world in motion, LIT test your own inner engineer and lets you discover the joy of experimenting with light at first hand.<br/>- The behaviour of light in LIT is physically accurate. That said, the amazing light paths you are going to build in LIT are possible but extremely hard to reproduce in real life. Our game gives you the opportunity to set up mirrors and glass pieces to reflect and refract a light beam as you wish.<br/>- Our puzzles are open-ended. We give you the rules and the tools, you show us how to solve the problem. We assigned a number of possible solutions to each level but don’t let those numbers fool you - we’re only waiting for the players to find solutions we haven't thought of.<br/>- Visuals threading on the thin line between cartoony and realistic. Good pacing. Relaxing music, which lets you zone in. All of that creates a unique, mysterious but warm atmosphere.<br/>- When light hits a mirror and it reflects, it hits glass and it bends. That’s all. And yet, it offers thousands of possibilities, which means each of our levels is different and unique.<br/>- LIT is extremely intuitive. Testing the game on multiple gaming events proved that it works for all age groups and all types of players. You want to find every solution and beyond? Searching for a game for your 5-year-old? Or maybe you’re trying to introduce your mum to gaming?<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>1 players

This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4™ version and the digital PS5™ version of this game.<br/><br/>Little League World Series Baseball 2022 allows you to Pitch, Slide, Slam, and Rally your way to Williamsport-glory as you compete to become the World Series CHAMPION of Little League®!<br/><br/>Get in the game and become a Little League Baseball World Series CHAMP!  Choose your team and showcase your skills as you compete through the bracket to see if you have what it takes to be named the Little League Baseball World Series Champion. Or, jump right into the action in an instant with Quick Play mode.  Play with your friends for exciting local multiplayer tournament action for up to four players. Customize the rules, select your stadiums and teams, and see who wins it all!<br/><br/>Little League World Series Baseball 2022  gives you the ability to choose your style!  Customize your team’s look, equipment, and batting style! Use Super Abilities like Slow Time and Bat Tank to turn the tide of the game to your favor. You can also earn player-boosting stickers that allow you to build the most powerful team!<br/><br/>Join the fun of Little League Baseball with Intense interactive plays that put you in command of executing incredible slides, catches, hits, and more to give your team the edge and bring home the win!<br/><br/>If you already own the PS4™ version of this game, you can get the PS5™ digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. SHORT
Listeria Wars is a real-time tactical game
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Listeria Wars is a real-time tactical game. You defend against the pathogenic microbes, attacking a single, infected organism. A key feature of Listeria Wars is the parallel viewing experience. In addition to the main game process, you can view the life of the human whose body has become the pathogenic battlefield.<br/><br/>The action in Listeria Wars takes place within the hero's body. You can see everything that happens to the host’s body in real-time. You manage various types of immune system cells, to protect the body and fend off attacks, from deadly contagions. The body’s immune system develops antibodies, as the action takes place.<br/>The game illustrates a person’s ability to be his own worst enemy: by neglecting personal hygiene, or ingesting rotten food, or failing to follow “social distancing”. You can also view the body’s use of involuntary immune system responses, such as vomiting and diarrhea. The goal is to protect and defend the infected body, from the deadly pathogens.<br/><br/>Key features:<br/>FUNNY ADVENTURES OF THE HERO: Watch the effects of malicious pathogens and influence the immune system’s response. <br/>CONVENIENT MANAGEMENT: Leukocytes attack intuitively, depending on the situation. Gamers can place these cells strategically and monitor the overall course of defense. <br/>PATHOGEN DIVERSITY: Realistic infections, microbes, viruses, bacteria, and other harmful pathogens. <br/>TACTICS: Manage unique leukocytes using their tactical advantages against the various pathogens, infecting the host.<br/>CATALOG: A log of medical descriptions of the types of immune cells, pathogens, and processes within the body.<br/>IMPROVEMENTS: To build a more effective defense, you may build improvements into the defenses of the immune system.<br/>ATMOSPHERIC MUSIC: Featuring an original soundtrack from Nuclear Mushroom Boom!<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>1 players

SHORT
Soar through the skies and become the best witch racer in the world!
LEGAL
PlayStation VR is not for use by children under the age of 12.<br/><br/>PlayStation VR and PlayStation Camera are required to play the PS4 version of this game.<br/><br/>VR games may cause some players to experience motion sickness.
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Take to the skies on a magic broom!<br/><br/>Become a guest student at a magic academy and take on all sorts of high-flying missions in this VR racing game based on the hit anime Little Witch Academia!<br/><br/>Race other students on flying brooms!<br/><br/>Form a tag team with another student and take advantage of the magic items on the courses to snag first place!<br/><br/>Purify the Stardust Ghosts!<br/><br/>There's not just racing, but shooting action, too! Work with a partner character to purify the ghosts in ghost hunt levels!<br/><br/>Customize your broom!<br/><br/>Use the points and tickets you gain from missions to buy new brooms and their power-up items, Broom Stars! Make your very own broom for hunts and races!<br/><br/>Enjoy the skies with Free Flight!<br/><br/>Fly around the skies of Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy at your leisure with other players on online multiplayer, unlocked after you finish Stage 4!<br/>(Online multiplayer requires a PlayStation®Plus subscription, sold separately.)<br/><br/>Each mission is accompanied by an original story! Enjoy interacting with the characters as you aim to complete your missions!<br/><br/><br/><Cast><br/>Akko: Megumi Han (JP) / Erica Mendez (EN)<br/>Lotte: Fumiko Orikasa (JP) / Stephanie Sheh (EN)<br/>Sucy: Michiyo Murase (JP) / Rachelle Heger (EN)<br/>Diana: Yoko Hikasa (JP) / Laura Post (EN)<br/>Amanda: Arisa Shida (JP) / Marianne Miller (EN)<br/>Constanze: Rie Murakawa (JP) / Jennifer Alyx (EN)<br/>Jasminka: Reina Ueda (JP) / Stephanie Sheh (EN)<br/>Neby: Yu Serizawa (JP) /  Laura Post (EN)<br/><br/>Main Theme Song “Dream Flight”<br/>Written and Composed by Yuiko Ohara<br/>Arranged by Minoru Yoshida<br/>Performed by YURiKA<br/><br/>Original Story:  TRIGGER / Yoh Yoshinari<br/>Supervision:   ”Little Witch Academia” Committee<br/>Director:   Junichi Yamamoto<br/>VR Production:   UNIVRS, Inc.<br/><br/>In addition, on PS5™ consoles: PlayStation Camera adaptor for PS Camera is required (no purchase necessary) go to Playstation.com/camera-adaptor; for the best PlayStation®VR experience on PS5™ we recommend using a DUALSHOCK®4 wireless controller.<br/>

LONG
THOSE GAMES are now more challenging and more fun than ever!<br/>Play upgraded, harder versions of minigames from THOSE GAMES 1 and 2!<br/>Take on the minigames you know and love, now with a whole new layer of hardcore challenge and replayability!<br/><br/>THOSE GAMES EXTREME is a new, more challenging THOSE GAMES experience. Enjoy flashier attacks, animations, and stage gimmicks for more excitement and drama than ever!<br/><br/>Featuring new versions of THOSE GAMES staples, all with updated visuals, including Pin Pull, Number Tower, Color Lab, Knock-Back Shooter, Draw & Guard, and Spellbinding Scroll (now upgraded to Survival Scroll!).<br/><br/>Are you ready for the hardest instalment in the THOSE GAMES series yet? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!<br/><br/>Key Features<br/>・A new instalment in the THOSE GAMES series, with a focus on higher difficulty.<br/>・Features familiar minigames with updated visuals for a fresh new look.<br/>・Enjoy bite-sized gaming challenges to your hearts' content, with 155 stages across six different minigames!<br/>・Compete against other players from around the world in Rank-Up Challenges.<br/>・Use the coins you earn in-game to get plates and titles from the Gotcha! machine.<br/>・Combine plates and titles to create and customize your own Title Plate.<br/>・View global leaderboards updated every month in Latest Rankings.<br/>・Complete a variety of different missions to earn rewards.<br/><br/>*Some minigame stages from THOSE GAMES and THOSE GAMES 2 also appear in this game as tutorial stages.<br/>

SHORT
Explore ancient ruins with the alchemist Noah and her trusty cat companion!
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Port Manacloud—a nation that owes its power and prosperity to its alchemists. Noah, an alchemical prodigy, is journeying across the skies in her airship when she discovers mysterious floating ruins. As she draws closer to investigate, a cat leaps on board. The cat accuses Noah of being a tomb raider and unleashes a storm that sends her vessel crashing down. In need of parts to repair her ship and driven by curiosity, Noah enters the ruins...<br/><br/>A Casual Roguelite Action Game<br/>Explore dungeons that shift with each playthrough and sweep through foes along the way. Use recruitable allies, "Lilliputs," and items you've collected to defeat the ruin bosses. If you get knocked out during your adventure, never fear—you can use the items you've earned to power up Noah and come back stronger than ever!<br/><br/>Repair your Airship, Reap the Benefits<br/>As you venture through the ruins, you'll collect mana to repair and upgrade facilities aboard your airship. These facilities will give you boosts to make your next adventure smoother. Each facility gives different boosts, so choose how you want to power up Noah.<br/><br/>Unique Parties, Unique Combos<br/>Recruit the Lilliputs you've acquired into a dungeon crawling party. Attack combos change depending on the order of your lineup—choose from 40+ Lilliputs to customize your party and maximize your power.<br/>

LONG
Dive into a Fairytale - There once was Elise , a vibrant and ambitious young lass with a big dream – becoming filthy rich. In spite of this, the stars didn’t seem to have reserved our protagonist much fortune in life. Elise, who came from humble beginnings, had no choice but to spend her days away assisting her fellow neighbours with menial tasks to make a living.<br/>One day, Elise discovers a pair of beautiful shiny red shoes buried in her backyard – what a surprise! Bewitched, Elise embarks on a fearful journey that pulls her closer and closer into the heart of the mysterious Woods!<br/>Will Elise risk it all for the sake of a dream come true, or settle for her humble day-to-day life? The ending of this tale is yours to write…<br/>Venture into the Woods - Little Goody Two Shoes is a horror narrative adventure game, set in a hand-painted fairy tale environment. There are 10 possible endings to fit your choices and actions in the game.<br/>But there’s more than meets the eye here, as you must also manage multiple aspects of Elise’s life in the village to stay alive. Remember, all decisions matter in this story!<br/>During the day, you will need to strengthen Elise’s bonds with her fellow villagers and work to make a living by playing fun minigames.<br/>But once the moon rises, make sure to keep Elise fed, healthy and sane in the multiple encounters with deadly foes as she makes her way further into the Woods.<br/>- Suspicion – Kieferberg is a small and devout village, which means Elise will need to carefully navigate her relationships with the villagers to avoid arousing suspicion of witchcraft and be left to die in the Woods as punishment. <br/>- Exploration & Puzzles – At night, Elise can roam around the Woodlands, a mystical and phantasmagorical  realm where enigmas and deadly enemies await as she tries to uncover its secrets.<br/>- Survival & Resource Management –  Through a limited day and night cycle Elise will need to carefully manage her needs if she wants to stay alive to finish her tale.<br/>- Love Interests – Get struck by Cupid’s arrow and fall in love with the charming bachelorettes of Kieferberg. In this all-female cast of romanceable characters, unlock dreamy date scenes and storylines for each of them.<br/>

Offline play only<br/>1 players

LONG
From Yasuhiro Wada, the creator of Harvest Moon, comes a new experience packed with delicious dishes, places to explore, magical characters and… a dragon's egg?! It's an exciting mix of ingredients that makes Little Dragons Café the tastiest game in town!<br/><br/>When two young twins discover they're in charge of the family café, it's a real recipe for adventure. Not only are there customers to serve, but there's the mystery of their mother's sudden illness to unravel and a baby dragon to raise too! Explore the island around the café, farm and catch your own ingredients, help your dragon grow and make new friends along the way. And who knows, you might even make the Little Dragons Café into the hottest attraction for miles around!<br/>

LONG
Gridrunner. Revenge of the Mutant Camels. Tempest 2000. Llamatron. In the British gaming universe of the 80s and 90s, nobody made games like Jeff Minter. Now, in a new interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse, you can play the history of one of the weirdest, wildest game developers to ever exist – a man who loved shooters and sheep, lasers and llamas.<br/><br/>LLAMASOFT<br/><br/>Journey back in time to an era of cassette tapes, photocopied zines, and README.TXT. An era in which a kid with a Commodore VIC-20 and dreams of radioactive sheep could become one of Britain's best-known game makers. A virtual museum of design documents, playable games, and all-new video features tell the fascinating story of a true independent game designer.<br/><br/>PLAY THE ACCLAIMED ORIGINALS<br/><br/>Llamasoft: The Jeff Minter Story includes 42 classic games from 8 different platforms, from Jeff Minter's earliest work on the Sinclair ZX81 and Commodore VIC-20, to later work on the Spectrum, Commodore 64 and Atari 800, and deep into the 16-bit era with the Atari ST and Atari Jaguar. <br/><br/>GRIDRUNNER: REMASTERED<br/><br/>Jeff's signature shooter masterpiece Gridrunner gets an all-new look from Digital Eclipse, updated into thrilling modern graphics and sound – while still running the core of the Commodore 64 version for 100% gameplay accuracy.<br/><br/>GAMES, GAMES, GAMES<br/><br/>Sheep In Space. Andes Attack. Attack of the Mutant Camels. Matrix. Metagalactic Llamas Battle at the Edge of Time. Hellgate. Laser Zone. And many more. All the Minter classics you've heard of (and several you probably haven't), now with new quality-of-life features to make playing them more fun than ever before.<br/><br/>Two of Jeff Minter's earliest "light synthesizers," Psychedelia and Colourspace, are also included, with all-new options and features optimized for controller-based play. Finally, Jeff's demo of Attack of the Mutant Camels for the unreleased Konix Multi-System console is also included.<br/><br/>THE GOLD MASTER SERIES<br/><br/>New from Digital Eclipse (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection, Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration, The Making of Karateka), the Gold Master Series presents iconic games in an innovative "interactive documentary" format, putting the shared history of games and their creators into one comprehensive package.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>2 players<br/>PS4 Pro Enhanced

SHORT
Manage your workers and create awesome stuff as you grow your dream factory!
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Imagine a magical factory, appearing right in your living room. A carefully planned masterpiece, where diligent workers throw together anything customers want. Rubber ducks and dressers, drones and electric guitars, scooters and other wonderful goods can be created from many different materials and sold for hard cash – cash you invest right back into your factory to get more machines, more workers and grow your business. In Little Big Workshop you become a factory tycoon!<br/><br/>Real factories - made FUN<br/>You are the Big Boss and it’s time to take charge of your very own tabletop factory. Organize the factory floor, manage your workers, purchase machinery, and design efficient production lines - all within the time-limit and to your client's satisfaction! <br/><br/>An open-ended sandbox-experience<br/>Take it easy, it’s a sandbox-experience where you think, ponder and poke at things until you get it to work the way you’d like. Supply products to clients and an ever-changing market, as you produce over 50 unique product types, built from multiple parts and pieces - all of which can be created with different materials and production methods. No two factories should ever look the same.<br/><br/>Tiny hands, big dreams<br/>Start out with just a small workshop and expand to a desk-filling factory. Unlock ever fancier machines, add even more production methods, and most of all, more room. Soon enough you’ll be running multiple production lines, producing hundreds of advanced products each day, and watching with joy as your cute workers do the actual work.<br/><br/>Features:<br/>• Varying industries and a wide range of products<br/>• Focus on practical problems, not on values, economics, or logistics<br/>• Organize all steps of the production on a blueprint<br/>• Factories grow as you unlock more desk space<br/>• Fully simulated Day/Night-cycle<br/>• Take care of your workers! Work them too hard and they drop like flies<br/>• Cute model-town art-style<br/>

LONG
This definitive edition of the multiple-award-winning hit by master storytellers The Chinese Room is remastered and includes all bonus content of the original. <br/><br/>Little Orpheus is a technicolor side-scrolling adventure game inspired by classic movies like Flash Gordon, Sinbad and The Land that Time Forgot. Join our bold yet hapless hero Comrade Ivan Ivanovich as he explores lost civilizations, undersea kingdoms, prehistoric jungles and lands beyond imagination. Gasp as he battles the subhuman tribe of the Menkv and escapes the clutches of dreadful monsters! Cheer as he triumphs over impossible odds and untold dangers in the subterranean worlds!<br/><br/>With stunning visuals, brilliant acting and a world-class score, Little Orpheus is a subterranean epic you’ll never forget. Comrades, to the center!<br/><br/>Features<br/><br/>•	A stunning, colorful world remastered with hi-res textures, new moves and animations, enhanced graphics and lighting effects, and more<br/><br/>•	A gripping story full of humor and adventure by the award-winning masters at The Chinese Room, creators of Dear Esther and Everybody’s Gone to the Rapture<br/><br/>•	Award-winning vocal performances and a world-class music score by BAFTA-winning composer Jessica Curry and Jim Fowler<br/><br/>•	Includes the bonus 9th episode A Rush of Onion to the Head and the Lost Recordings Mode<br/>

SHORT
Enjoy amazing rides, exciting equestrian games and much more!
LONG
Run your own riding stable full of horses and take good care of your animals and your guests. Ride freely around the open game world, through a wide variety of landscapes. The riding controls are intuitive. Speed, skill and courage are required for the mounted games – riding games that are both thrilling and fun! Train hard and claim victory in the tournament!<br/><br/>• Choose from different horse breeds<br/>• Enjoy challenging hacks through the open game world<br/>• Adventure through the exciting story mode<br/>• Take part in thrilling races in four disciplines (orienteering, hurdle races, checkpoint races and slalom)<br/>• Complete tournaments with four fast-paced riding games<br/>• Find and collect treasure chests to unlock new outfits<br/>• Have a blast with five exciting mini-games<br/>• Learn useful knowledge about horses and hospitality<br/>• Play against your friends in multiplayer mode<br/>• Child-safe! No in-game purchases or advertising.<br/>

Offline play only<br/>1 players

SHORT
Box by Box, Build Your Business
LONG
Welcome to Loaders Inc, where speed, precision, and style determine your success in the ultimate moving and decorating challenge. Your mission? Clear out old homes, load every last item into the truck, and transform new houses into dream spaces, all before time runs out!<br/><br/>Every second counts as you race against the clock to collect furniture, boxes, and decorations. Upgrade your crew, boost their speed and stamina, and increase your time limit with each attempt. The faster and smarter you work, the more your moving business will thrive.<br/><br/>Once the loading is done, it's time for you to get creative. Arrange and decorate carefully to impress your customers, earn top satisfaction scores, and watch as you grow from a small startup into a decorating powerhouse.<br/><br/>Loaders Inc is fast, fun, and endlessly replayable. It blends time management, strategy, and design into one satisfying experience that proves hard work can be this enjoyable.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>Vibration function supported (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players<br/>Remote Play supported<br/>DUALSHOCK 4 vibration

LONG
Loading Human is the adventure game of the future. Your dying father, an esteemed scientist, has summoned you to his Antarctic base to undergo an intensive interstellar quest: retrieve the Quintessence, an elusive energy source that will help reverse the aging process.<br/><br/>Built exclusively for Virtual Reality, Loading Human takes full advantage of VR hardware and motion controllers to create a completely immersive experience. With unparalleled freedom to move and explore as you wish, Loading Human pushes the boundaries of VR, placing you directly in an emotionally charged story that makes you feel like you are truly living the game. Along your journey through Loading Human, you will make difficult decisions and interact physically with other characters.<br/><br/>By raising the stakes of your actions through emotional connectivity, moral choices, and real consequences, Loading Human isn’t just a game you play it’s a game you experience.  <br/><br/><br/>1 player<br/>5GB minimum save size<br/>HD Video Output 720p,1080i,1080p<br/>PlayStation®Move motion controller and PlayStation®Eye camera optional<br/>PlayStation®VR and PlayStation®Camera is required to play this product<br/><br/>In addition, on PS5™ consoles: PlayStation Camera adaptor for PS Camera is required (no purchase necessary) go to www.playstation.com/camera-adaptor; for the best PlayStation®VR experience on PS5™ we recommend using a DUALSHOCK®4 wireless controller.<br/><br/>Download of this product is subject to the PlayStation Network Terms of Service and our Software Usage Terms plus any specific additional conditions applying to this product. LONG
You’re an indebted angler, trapped in a vicious cycle of borrowing and desperation. One dark, endless night at sea you haul up something unnatural: a talking fish named Cagliuso. It promises you riches — but its bargains come with terrifying strings.<br/><br/>In LOAN SHARK, the nets you cast bring more than fish. They pull you toward sacrifice, secrets, and a deadline you may never meet. The “loan shark” isn’t just metaphoric — something is stalking the waters, your time is running out, and every deal you strike pushes you deeper into the unknown.<br/><br/>• Short, intense experience – Designed for a compact but unforgettable playthrough.<br/>• Underwater eye-cam mechanic – Watch the lure in submerged view, anticipate the bite, then pull fast while the depths watch you.<br/>• Fish & gut mechanic – After you reel them in, you must gut the fish yourself… carefully. Mistakes may cut you.<br/>• Surreal dialogues & meaningful choices – Meet Cagliuso and barter with a one-eyed talking fish. Every choice alters your path.<br/>• Time pressure & looming threat – The loan shark is coming. The clock ticks. Something hides in the darkness.<br/>• Atmospheric horror & creeping dread – The deep sea becomes your adversary; the familiar becomes monstrous.<br/>

Offline play only<br/>Vibration function supported (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players

SHORT
The legendary zombie hunter Juliet is back in 4K!
LONG
Throw logic to the wind and embrace your instincts! The legendary zombie hunter Juliet is finally back!<br/><br/>Lollipop Chainsaw, which sold 1.24 million copies worldwide, is back with the latest graphics!<br/>The cheerleader Juliet, born into a family of zombie hunters, uses her trusty chainsaw to rip and tear through the undead! But now that RePOP adds speedier chainsaw action and auto-fire for her chainsaw blaster, the action never slows down till the very end! And it's not just the gameplay that's been improved, the visuals and soundtrack have been powered up too! Don't miss out on this unparalleled zombie hunting adventure!<br/><br/>＜STORY＞<br/>The story starts in San Romero High School, the largest high school in the district, somewhere on the west coast of the US of A. Protagonist Juliet Starling, is an exemplary student of San Romero who passionately loves cheerleading. Unbeknownst to most, however, her family, the Starlings, has been a lineage of zombie hunters, guiding the undead to beyond  since ancient times…<br/>The incident unfolds on Juliet's birthday. She heads to school to meet her boyfriend, but as she pedals her bicycle into the school grounds, she is greeted by the sight of her former schoolmates, who have all been turned into zombies!<br/>

Online play optional<br/>1 players<br/>1 network players

LONG
Collect all gold in the level and escape! But watch out for the enemies and traps in the labyrinthine levels! The Runner can blast floors, so strategically use this technique to capture the gold imbedded in blocks, or entrap your enemies in the blocks! Use your wisdom and techniques to complete all the levels!<br/><br/>Local Multiplayer Mode with up to 2 players!<br/>Using two controllers, you can play together with your buddy! Cooperation is the key to winning! By working together, you can capture the gold that is impossible to get alone!<br/><br/>Create levels and characters and share with players around the world!<br/>You can create your original levels and characters in the Craft Mode! Share your levels and characters via online with players around the world! Show your specialty levels to the world, or play levels created by other world creators! <br/><br/>And much, much more!<br/>

SHORT
Roll, Jump, Bounce and ‘Boing’ Your Way Through a Mysterious Moonlit Fairground
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Experience LocoRoco™ Midnight Carnival originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters. <br/><br/>Night has fallen and the LocoRoco are in the mood for some midnight mayhem…<br/><br/>Roll, jump, bounce and ‘boing’ your way through a mysterious moonlit fairground built by the mischievous BuiBui. Just watch out for the fiendish traps and devious hazards they’ve left behind!<br/><br/>Enjoy 16 classic LocoRoco levels in this playful platformer originally released in 2009.<br/><br/>This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.<br/>

1 players<br/>Remote Play supported

SHORT
Build Your Play.
LONG
Lokko is currently in Open Beta. Some features are limited or still in development and may not work as expected. Player inventories, content, and unlocks may reset when the game exits Open Beta.
<br/>We're building Lokko alongside our community, and your feedback shapes every update. To submit in-game feedback, press L3+R3 on DualSense®.
<br/>Email: support@appymonkeys.com 
<br/>Discord: https://discord.gg/6YazUPKNvh
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>*Welcome to Lokko*
<br/>LOKKO is a unique 3D platformer where fun meets creativity. Create and share challenging levels across PS5®, PC and iOS seamlessly and in real time. Create your own avatar and design your own enemies and bosses. Trade your creations, challenge other players, and compete to make the most creative level out there. Full DualSense® support across every platform. 
<br/>
<br/>*3D Level Editor*
<br/>Build and share your own 3D platforming levels with our intuitive in-game editor. Connect timers, accelerators, and switches, drop in enemies and bosses, and design challenges to share with friends. Full controller and keyboard/mouse support.
<br/>
<br/>*2D Level Editor*
<br/>Create challenging 2D levels fast. Place platforms to leap across, enemies to dash through, and obstacles to dodge — then play-test in real time as you build. 
<br/>
<br/>*Avatar Editor*
<br/>Customize your character endlessly. Add, delete, and paint blocks to create the look you want, then push your avatar straight into all our gameplay. 
<br/>
<br/>*Enemy Editor*
<br/>Reshape the look and behavior of every NPC enemy. Build, paint, and tweak — then drop your creations into the Level Editor instantly to see them in action. 
<br/>
<br/>*Car Track Editor*
<br/>Create exciting tracks to drive on. Customize your car with wheels, engines and spoilers in our Car Workshop. Paint and add to your car chassis to get your coolest looking car.
<br/>
<br/>*LABS*
<br/>A playground for our upcoming, experimental game modes. Try them early and let us know what you think!
<br/>
<br/>*LOCAL 2-PLAYER MODE*
<br/>Challenge your friends to a fun, platforming race in our local PvP Mode.
<br/>
<br/>*STORY*
<br/>Lokko Pizza is the best pizza joint in the world — and they hand-deliver smoking-hot pizzas anywhere on the globe. Run by Lokko and his brother, Chef Lokko, the shop has built its name on fresh dough, real ingredients, and an impossible promise: from a sweet Hawaiian Surprise to a cheesy Sicilian Special, your pizza arrives hot, fast, and right to your door — no matter where in the world you may be.
<br/>But across town - Goobol, the CEO of a soulless fast-food empire, has built his fortune on cheap, frozen, factory-pressed pizza — and he can't stand competition. With an army of minions at his command, Goobol will do anything to shut Lokko down and force the world to eat his terrible pizzas.
<br/>Lokko isn't backing down. He'll run, drive, and even teleport through space and time to get a fresh, wholesome pizza into the hands of every hungry customer!
<br/>The world deserves a better slice. Help Lokko deliver it.
<br/>
<br/>"PS5" is a registered trademark or trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc.
<br/>"DualSense" is a registered trademark or trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc.<br/>

Just a usual day. You're heading out for a walk just like you do it every day. You're stepping out of your apartment when all of a sudden, you see a little girl who looks frightened. She asks to help her find her mother... <br/>From now on everything goes beyond normal. You are trapped in a nightmare that is taking place in this dwelling. But don't even try to escape - you have to help this girl.<br/>In this game, you will face paranormal creepy things that you need to defeat on your way to freedom. LONG
Lone Wolf: A Post Apocalyptic Beat-Em Up Role Playing Game. This action/adventure game lets a player use martial arts skills, weapons, and turn into a werewolf to fight their way through a world set in the aftermath of post nuclear devastation.<br/><br/>This game was made with the love of the beat-em up arcade machines and console games of the 1980's and 1990's, taking some of the mechanics of these games mixed with some more modern gameplay.<br/><br/>Features:<br/>• Main character "Lone Wolf" can transform into a werewolf to tear apart enemies.<br/>• Main character "Brok" is a wrestler that can transform into a berserker hulk to crush enemies.<br/>• Characters have special fighting abilities, improving their skills transparently as you play.<br/>• Currently there are 28 playable weapons! Characters use weapons that they are skilled in, some can only be used by certain characters.<br/>• Playable characters can be AI driven and the AI can be customized per character, and switched to AI on the fly.<br/>• 6 Unique death animations per character, different special moves trigger the death animations on foes.<br/>• Sneak kills can be made in some shadowed areas of the game.<br/>• Story Mode with comic book style cutscenes.<br/>• Fighter mode to battle out with other players or computer controlled opponents.<br/>• 2D animation for the characters in a 3D environment give it a unique look and feel.<br/>• Couch co-op, up to 4 players.<br/>• Unlockable characters, Fighter levels, and a secret play mode.<br/>• Open world to explore and discover its secrets and have encounters with the denizens of the world in the aftermath.<br/>• NPC character interaction and dialogue, there are branching quests and event driven dialogues that the main character can progress through.<br/>• Customizable difficulty, camera control, controls style, and player input!<br/>

Offline play only<br/>Vibration function and trigger effect required (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>4 players<br/>PS4 Pro Enhanced<br/>DUALSHOCK 4 vibration

LONG
Cliff Rockslide is a beloved news reporter from Butterfly Valley. And Butterfly Valley is one of those very unremarkable places where nothing happens. Except once you look a bit closer and you see that actually, those are the exact places where everything happens.<br/><br/>Local News with Cliff Rockslide is a point-and-shoot interactive story about Cliff Rockslide, Butterfly Valley's epic news, zombies, cults, mysterious cubes, and everything and anything that can happen in a small town. The story is hand-crafted by one of Finland's top comedians and it can be described as country-side comedy.<br/><br/>Your mission in the game is to shoot all the action to your camera as the freshly-hired cameraperson of Cliff. Follow the intense (and nonsense) action, point your cam, and shoot those shots.<br/><br/>• First-person view of the story through your camera's lens<br/>• A perfect mix of point-and-click, visual novel, and FPS<br/>• Complete minigames, accomplish challenges and solve puzzles<br/>

SHORT
RPG exploring modern conflict, language barriers, and empathy during war.
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Long Gone Days is an RPG set in the real world about human connection during war, focusing on civilians, language barriers, and borders.<br/><br/>Follow Rourke, young man trained from birth to be a sniper for The Core— a subterranean paramilitary state.<br/><br/>On his first mission, he is sent to the surface under orders of great significance. Motivated to finally be able to show the fruits of his training, he carries out his first orders to perfection only to find out that The Core was far from being the noble organization he thought he knew.<br/><br/>A Nuanced Look at War: Experience the clash of modern conflict against civilian life through the contrast of intense RPG combat and slower, slice-of-life gameplay.<br/><br/>Communication is Key: As Long Gone Days is set in the real world, you'll encounter several language barriers. Recruit interpreters in order to communicate with others and forge bonds beyond borders.<br/><br/>Keep Morale High: Choose dialogue options wisely to boost morale in battle. Every character has distinct personality traits and motivations.<br/><br/>Sniper Mode: Long Gone Days has two battle systems. Using Rourke's rifle, spot your enemies and take down your targets.<br/><br/>No Random Encounters: Long Gone Days features front-view, turn-based battles with a body-targeting system. Every battle is hand-crafted and directly related to the plot.<br/>

1 players

SHORT
Break blocks. Solve puzzles. Relax.
LONG
THE GAME:<br/>In LoBlocks the player must destroy all the blocks to advance to the next level. To do this, they must solve various challenging puzzles by matching blocks of the same color and quantity.<br/><br/>FEATURES:<br/><br/>40 challenging levels<br/><br/>2 game modes (Arcade and Classic with levels)<br/><br/>Online leaderboard for Arcade mode<br/><br/>Relaxing atmosphere<br/><br/>Original LoFi soundtrack<br/><br/>Pixel art visuals<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Vibration function supported (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players

LONG
Just you and your bike - take it on a thrilling ride down an unspoiled mountain landscape. Make your way through thick forests, narrow trails, and wild rivers. Race, jump, slide and try not to crash - all the way from the peak to the valley!<br/><br/>Key Features:<br/>• Travel to the Lonely Mountains! Ride along quiet mountain lakes, majestic forests and steep canyons<br/>• A custom physics system lets you carefully drop from boulder to boulder, sprint over abysses or slide through muddy grounds<br/>• Find your own way - take a relaxing scenic route or go off-road to find the fastest way to the finish line!<br/>• No audience, no barrier tapes - experience a beautiful nature unspoiled by men<br/>• Find the perfect bike for your playstyle and unlock dozens of paint jobs and outfits!<br/>• Compete with friends and prove your speed-running skills on the leaderboards<br/>

SHORT
Make fierce L.O.L. Surprise! dolls for fans around the world.
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Fans around the world can't wait to unbox their own L.O.L. Surprise! doll - and you're about to make their dreams come true! Choose your character and bring the L.O.L. Surprise! doll store to life, as you collect fierce dolls with glitter, hearts, diamonds, and more. No matter your age, there's just enough challenge to bring out the fierce L.O.L. Surprise! doll-maker in you!<br/><br/>This trip around the world is full of surprises! Be rewarded with new characters, and stickers when you complete each stage. Then display them in fabulous fashion shows and music concerts. You can even team up with friends on this world tour, with same-screen co-operative play for up to four players. With 30 stages in five cities to play, you'll soon build your own L.O.L. Surprise! collection.<br/><br/>PLAY AS YOUR FAVORITE CHARACTER – Become an L.O.L. Surprise! doll and unlock special versions of your character<br/><br/>TAKE ON CHALLENGES – Can you deliver every fan’s dream L.O.L. Surprise! ball in time?<br/><br/>TRAVEL THE WORLD – Play 30 stages across five new cities including New Fab City, Queen Island and Neon Desert.<br/><br/>PUT ON A SHOW – Show off your collection in fashion shows and music concerts<br/><br/>PARTY WITH FRIENDS – Up to 4 players can team up in the L.O.L. Surprise! dolls store!<br/><br/>PS5™ features:<br/><br/>4K resolution<br/><br/>This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4™ version and the digital PS5™ version of this game.<br/><br/>If you already own the PS4™ version of this game, you can get the PS5™ digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. Owners of a PS4™ disc copy must insert it into the PS5™ every time they want to download or play the PS5™ digital version. PS4™ game disc owners who buy the PS5™ Digital Edition disc-free console will not be able to get the PS5™ version at no extra cost.<br/>

LONG
Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack! <br/><br/>This hidden object game lets you see the world through an alien TV show while following the adventures of Earth resident Shaun. He has to prove the existence of aliens no matter what! Hunt for items in 25 vibrant and detailed locations, including Area 51, the dream world, and even outer space!<br/><br/>Features:<br/><br/>- Find over 250 items hidden in 25 colorful levels<br/>- Follow the adventures of earthling Shaun as he struggles to prove the existence of aliens<br/>- Enjoy a hidden object mechanic based on fun text hints<br/>- Explore a highly interactive environment — turn off cloaking holograms, glimpse the characters' dreams or just eat all the food!<br/>- Don't strain your eyes — you can zoom in on all locations<br/>- Take a break after a difficult day on Earth by enjoying light humor, music, and pop culture references<br/>

Build Defenses and Battle against the Clockwork horde in this 2D Action RPG / Tower Defense hybrid. Experience a gripping story, which unfolds as you progress through 75 Days of warfare, aided by a collection of turrets, traps and special attacks.<br/><br/>• Place Kingdom Force units to defend your capitol in a brand new Endless Mode - Antonia Defense!<br/>• Build up your fortifications each day to defend against a timed Clockwork assault. SHORT
Brain training mini-games that test logic, memory, math, and creativity.
LONG
LogIQ Boost: Elevate Your Mental Potential
<br/>
<br/>LogIQ Boost is a comprehensive brain-training experience designed for players of all ages, blending education with entertainment. Whether you are a student looking to sharpen your focus, an adult staying mentally fit, or a senior maintaining cognitive agility, LogIQ Boost provides the perfect platform for your daily mental workout.
<br/>Challenge Yourself and Track Your Progress
<br/>
<br/>Test your limits with 12 exciting mini-games specifically crafted to sharpen your logic, memory, math, reflexes, and creativity.
<br/>
<br/>    Single Player Mode: Train at your own pace and master each cognitive category individually.
<br/>
<br/>    Survival Mode: The ultimate challenge! Experience all mini-games back-to-back to calculate your "Brain Age" and visualize your mental growth with tangible data.
<br/>
<br/>The Perfect Family Activity
<br/>
<br/>LogIQ Boost is more than just a solo journey; it is a productive family activity. Compare scores, challenge each other’s high scores, and discover who the true "Brain Champion" of the household is. Its intuitive design makes it accessible for children while remaining rewarding and challenging for adults.
<br/>Why LogIQ Boost?
<br/>
<br/>    Comprehensive Training: Exercises covering five core cognitive areas.
<br/>
<br/>    Fun and Educational: A seamless gameplay structure that transforms learning into an engaging experience.
<br/>
<br/>    Adaptive Difficulty: A balanced experience that evolves alongside your skills.
<br/>
<br/>Get ready to unlock your full potential. Whether your goal is to boost your IQ or enjoy a meaningful challenge with your family, LogIQ Boost offers the perfect balance of entertainment and mental development.<br/>

1 players

SHORT
Grab your skis and your friends and shred the Lonely Mountains again!
LONG
Crash over and over until you master the mountain in the snowy followup to Lonely Mountains: Downhill. Now also including 2-8 person crossplatform multiplayer - work your way down the slopes as a group sharing a small number of checkpoints, or risk it all in a breakneck race to the base!<br/><br/>Take a deep breath, count to three, and… go! Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders is a game that balances serious challenge with a relaxing atmosphere. Slice through deep snow, skitter over ice lakes, and leap into the air in spectacular jumps, bringing your friends along for the ride.<br/><br/>PLAY SOLO OR RACE TOGETHER<br/><br/>Snow Riders also adds a brand new feature to the Lonely Mountains world – online multiplayer! Work your way down the mountain as a team in co-op, carefully sharing your limited checkpoints, or compete in a breakneck race to the base in versus mode. Available for 2-8 players, with multiplatform crossplay.<br/><br/>FANCY A CHALLENGE?<br/><br/>Push your skills to the limit in solo mode. Perform daredevil tricks or try to best your time for a spot on the leaderboard. Or you can take the road less travelled, discovering shortcuts as you explore the slope. Unlock new equipment, outfits and tricks as you play!<br/><br/>Whether you’re looking for a challenge or a chilled out vacation with friends, Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders is the perfect winter getaway.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
PS Plus required for online play<br/>Supports up to 8 online players with PS Plus<br/>In-game purchases optional<br/>Online play optional<br/>Vibration function supported (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players

SHORT
Search for your missing roommate in your apartment.
LONG
A surreal, closed-door maze<br/><br/>It all starts with a strange voice message left by Fael, your roommate. Little by little, the apartment you thought you knew multiplies into a multifaceted maze filled with mysterious puzzles.<br/><br/>In search of a sign of life from your roommate, you'll have to learn to find your bearings in this enclosed space with its strange and lonely atmosphere. Advance room by room, decipher the clues left behind, and embark on the adventure that has transformed your apartment into a surreal maze.<br/><br/>But be careful: as you progress through this maze, you will be led to question the very nature of reality. Will you be able to connect the clues and piece together the puzzle left behind by Fael?<br/><br/>An immersive and nostalgic escape game<br/><br/>To find Fael, your wits will be your only ally. Each apartment is a puzzle in its own right, with its own logic behind a multitude of puzzles. But don't expect to find a comfort zone: the messages left by your roommate have been designed to confuse you...<br/><br/>However, this maze has a common thread that connects each apartment to the others: your actions in one place can have repercussions elsewhere, sometimes with unexpected consequences. All kinds of machines, created by Fael's genius, will be at your disposal to help you progress, such as the Game Leaf, a strange game console that is essential to your progress.<br/><br/>Activate mysterious mechanisms and impact your environment to solve puzzles and continue your exploration. From a simple living room to a room overgrown with vegetation, a cinema, a laboratory, and many other rooms, everything is connected, everything is one.<br/><br/>GAME FEATURES:<br/>A kaleidoscope of apartments and atmospheres. <br/>Explore a variety of environments from the imagination of comic book author Benoît “Beloup” Leloup. From one apartment to another, discover a world full of cultural references and colors, reflecting Fael's dreamy personality.<br/><br/>The Game Leaf: a tribute to the 90s. <br/>Use your Game Leaf, a mysterious console straight out of the 90s. Solve puzzles in the form of nostalgic mini-games and unlock new areas to explore. Each apartment is a piece of the puzzle that will lead you to the truth about Fael's disappearance.<br/><br/>A cabinet of curiosities. <br/>The apartments are filled with oddities that will challenge your imagination and logic. Manipulate strange machines, let your natural curiosity run wild, experiment with solutions, and observe the fruits of your efforts.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>1 players<br/>Remote Play supported

SHORT
―Welcome to the Mysterious Grimoire―
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Logiart Grimoire is a puzzle game that combines the number puzzle "Logiart" and the word puzzle "Fusion" in which you deduce combinations from clues.<br/>Solve and clear the Logiart puzzles.<br/>Fuse the cleared puzzles to create new ones.<br/>Repeat the process of solving the newly created puzzles...<br/>...and work together with Emil to aim for the restoration of the grimoire.<br/><br/>- Story -<br/>You, who have taken hold of the Logiart grimoire, encounter Emil, the custodian of the grimoire.<br/>Originally, the grimoire was the book that could solve "Logiart", but the magic it held has gone awry, transforming it into an enigmatic grimoire.<br/>Most of the "Logiart" can no longer be unraveled.<br/>You, guided by the Logiart's grimoire, will be able to solve its mysteries and once again restore the ability to solve "Logiart." <br/>Join Emil in unraveling the mysteries of the mysterious grimoire and restore it to its original state.<br/><br/>- Features of the game -<br/>“Logiart”<br/>Logiart is a "Picture Logic Puzzle" that uses vertical and horizontal numbers as hints to complete illustrations.<br/>It has simple and easy-to-understand rules, making it accessible for anyone to play.<br/>Various assist functions are also included, allowing for a smooth gameplay experience.<br/>You can also choose to turn off the assist functions if desired.<br/>“Fusion”<br/>The puzzles solved in Logiart serve as materials to unlock new puzzles.<br/>By correctly combining 2 or 3 materials through fusion, new puzzles are unlocked.<br/>To find the right combinations, read the text clues provided for each puzzle and use deduction.<br/>“Number of Logiart Puzzles”<br/>There are a total of 280 puzzles in various sizes.<br/>The available sizes are 5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x15, 30x30, and 40x30 for a total of 6 options.<br/>“Emil's Growth”<br/>Emil, who helps unravel the mysteries of the grimoire together, gains magical power every time you solve a Logiart puzzle.<br/>As Emil's magical power increases, you'll be able to fuse more puzzles.<br/>“Unlocking Grimoire Categories”<br/>Due to a malfunction in the grimoire, the categorized sections have become inaccessible.<br/>At first, there may be few categories available to browse, but as you progress through the game and solve specific puzzles, more categories will be unlocked.<br/>

Offline play only<br/>1 players

Speed, Style, and Steep Slopes Await. Become a Legend.
LONG
Experience the thrill of speed and precision in Longboard Skate Downhill Simulator, where every descent is a test of skill. Ride through beautifully crafted environments—from lush green forests to autumn-colored woods and sun-baked deserts—each with its own unique tracks and challenges. Whether racing against AI in World Tour, chasing the clock in Downhill Time, or exploring freely in Free Ride mode, every run offers an exhilarating experience.<br/>Feel the flow of movement with physics-based controls that make slides, turns, and jumps realistic. Adaptive triggers provide resistance for slides and tuck positions, while vibration feedback brings the terrain to life—every crack, bump, and fall feels authentic. Motion blur, subtle camera shake, and wind simulation add to the immersive sensation of downhill skating.<br/>Customize your ride with a variety of longboards, decks, wheels, and grip tapes to match your style and performance needs.<br/><br/>Key Features:<br/>	•	3 gameplay modes: World Tour , Downhill Time, Free Ride<br/>	•	8 visually distinct biomes with unique tracks and environmental sounds<br/>	•	Customizable longboards: decks, wheels, and grip tapes<br/>	•	Realistic physics-based downhill controls with adaptive triggers and vibration feedback<br/>	•	Advanced Photo Mode with free camera, depth of field, and cinematic filters<br/><br/>Master the slopes, perfect every turn, and enjoy the ultimate longboarding experience.<br/>

Offline play only<br/>Vibration function required (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players<br/>Remote Play supported

SHORT
Fix the chaos, drop the beat – electrifying action meets DIY music mayhem!
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Brace yourself for a wild ride where music meets mayhem! Look Mum No Computer takes you to the quirky, pixel-art universe of Soldersworth, as you join Sam and his Synthesizer sidekick, Kosmo, in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG to battle rogue household items and fix them from the inside — one electrifying beat at a time!
<br/> 
<br/>Key Features
<br/>Interactive Music Creation: Craft and upgrade unique modules that not only serve as powerful weapons but also form the instruments of the game’s evolving soundtrack.  Customize your playstyle and compose your own electronic music as you battle rogue machines
<br/>DIY Crafting System: Collect items and craft new modules inspired by creator Look Mum No Computer’s iconic designs, including the flamethrower module — a fiery nod to their infamous flamethrower organ.
<br/> Quirky Worlds to Explore: Warp into the strange and vibrant pixel-art landscapes inside machines, teeming with bizarre creatures, challenging quests, and epic boss fights.
<br/>Dynamic Combat:  Take on swarms of enemies using twin-stick controls, balancing your energy to fuel both your arsenal and your electrifying music.
<br/>For Music Lovers and Gamers Alike: Whether you're a fan of retro games, electronic music, or Look Mum No Computer's inventive DIY spirit, this game offers something you’ll love.
<br/> 
<br/>The Adventure Awaits
<br/>Travel through the world of Soldersworth’s rogue devices, meet unforgettable characters, and unravel the musical chaos inside. Will you repair the machines, conquer the bosses, and restore harmony—or lose the beat forever?<br/>

LONG
Looney Test is the ultimate quiz for anyone who’s ever wondered, “Am I a little weird… or completely off the rails?” Dive into 12 ridiculous multiple-choice questions that will test your silliness, challenge your inner clown, and reveal just how delightfully looney you truly are. Play solo for a personal dose of absurdity or take turns with friends to see who’s the biggest goofball in the group!<br/>Each answer secretly adds to your Looney Score, leading up to your grand reveal: the Looney Certificate! Will you be crowned a Mildly Goofy Goldfish or a Totally Bonkers Banana? There’s only one way to find out. Quick, wacky, and full of laughs, Looney Test turns every game night into a giggle-fest of pure nonsense and unfiltered fun.<br/>

LONG
In this psychological survival adventure, the masked protagonist must escape from a city ravaged by disease, by any means necessary. Starving and exhausted, he has begun to question how much of what he sees is even real.<br/><br/>Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut is a new kind of adventure where the choice of how to survive is up to you. Sneak through without firing a single shot, or kill everything in your path. Eat and sleep well, or resort to drugs to keep going. Search for survivors, or try to escape the city alone. Look after your mental health, or descend into madness. Lone Survivor is a game where your choices genuinely matter.<br/><br/>This extended edition of Jasper Byrne's horror masterpiece expands Lone Survivor's deep story with hundreds of tiny new details, more locations, more dialogue, more side quests, more craftable items, and even two completely new endings. Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut really is the ultimate version of this acclaimed game.<br/>

LONG
Loop is a puzzle game that will immerse you in a world of grid systems and vibrant colors. Your objective is to move the stones up, down, left, and right to place them in their correct positions. But beware, each stone moves simultaneously, and if there's no grid cell available in the direction it needs to go, it will teleport to the opposite side of the grid!<br/>Loop offers a puzzle experience with 6 chapters and hundreds of levels in its single-player mode. Additionally, there's a 2-player mode for you to enjoy with your friends, where you can compete to place the stones faster and more accurately.<br/>With its minimalist graphics and soothing music, Loop draws you into a relaxing atmosphere. If you're looking for a brain exercise and a new puzzle game to try, Loop is the perfect choice.<br/>

SHORT
With one month until the world ends, how will you spend each day?
LEGAL
To play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent. See PlayStation.com/bc for more details.
LONG
Your choices shape the world in this coming-of-age RPG set in 1980s rural Japan.<br/><br/>Step into the life of Nini, a newly earthbound teen who arrives in the quaint Japanese town of Ashihara in August 1983. Explore the town, befriend its people, and face off against the Kegai in turn-based battles where the outcomes depend on the relationships you’ve built and the decisions you’ve made. Use Nini’s special connection to the gods to reset the world, with each loop allowing Nini and his allies to relive the 8th month over and over until they get it right…or the Kegai overcome them entirely.<br/><br/><br/>■Live an Ordinary Life, Fight Extraordinary Enemies<br/>Build bonds with Ashihara's residents while protecting the town from the ever-present threat of the Kegai, repeating the cycle to uncover how your everyday actions impact your battles in the Underworld, and vice versa.<br/><br/>■Choices That Can Change the World<br/>Loop8’s emotion-driven AI system responds to every action you take and decision you make. Characters’ emotions and stories will vary greatly based on your choices, making each playthrough wholly unique.<br/><br/>■A Picturesque View of Rural Japan<br/>Your adventure takes place in a nostalgic and beautifully recreated snapshot of a rural Japanese townscape. Head downtown to recharge at a local restaurant, or hang out at the shops to strengthen your bonds with other characters.<br/><br/>■Relive the Past to Alter the Future <br/>Though the deadline for humanity's extinction draws ever closer, Ashihara's fate remains in your hands. Repeatedly return to the start of August, alter your actions, and see how they turn the tides of destiny across multiple endings.<br/>

SHORT
The Sleep of Reason Produces Monsters
LONG
Loretta is a housewife. Walter is a writer. Dragged from the glitz and glamor of 1940s New York City and thrust into a dilapidated farmhouse in the rural south, both are unsuccessful, struggling with their finances, and straining in their relationship. But when Loretta learns of her husband’s infidelity and a lucrative life insurance policy filed in his name, a grisly plan takes root. It is up to you to decide how far she should take it.<br/><br/>Become an accessory to Loretta’s crimes as she navigates a nightmare of her own creation. Engage with the locals through branching dialogue options, discover the right tools for putting an end to nosy neighbors, recover from the betrayal of a love gone wrong, and ultimately decide how Loretta’s story should end. Will you walk the high road and move on, or will you serve those who have wronged you their just desserts?<br/><br/><br/>FEATURES<br/><br/>Branching paths and multiple endings allow for a custom experience and opportunity for replay. Decide Loretta’s fate and explore the possible outcomes that await her. Whose side will you take in this story without heroes?<br/><br/>Meet a diverse cast of characters and figure out if they want to help you or hinder you. Make tenuous allegiances or cast old friendships aside at key opportunities as this twisted tale unfolds.<br/><br/>Solve cryptic puzzles, dive deeper into Loretta's imperfect past, and discover how deep her desperation will go when it comes to reclaiming control of her life.<br/><br/>Conceptually inspired by film noir, Loretta also pays homage to some of the greatest minds in horror, including Andrew Wyeth, Stephen King, Vladimir Nabokov and Alfred Hitchcock.<br/>
COMPATIBILITY_NOTICE
Offline play only<br/>Vibration function required (DualSense wireless controller)<br/>1 players<br/>Remote Play supported

LONG
Claire and her team are in trouble  again. Their airplane flew into a terrible storm and crashed on an uninhabited island in the middle of the ocean. When they woke up, our heroes went out in search of help. After wandering a while, Claire found a village of atlanteans and offered to help them get their homeland back, and to teach the wicked ruler of the underwater world a lesson.<br/><br/>Dare to travel an unknown country full of secrets and mysticism in this exciting casual strategy game, Lost Artifacts Golden Island!<br/>A multitude of varied quests, over 40 levels, a happy plot, simple and entertaining gameplay and a mysterious world – all this awaits you right now! Restore the warrior statues, overcome challenges, manage resources and construct buildings. Simple controls and a clear tutorial will help you easily get to grips with the basics of the game.<br/>Lost Artifacts Golden Island – restore Atlantis and defeat the villain!<br/>

LONG
Explore procedurally generated labyrinths in this challenging, narrative-rich roguelike. Master tense, deep combat. Slide blocks of ancient ruins. Defeat bestial abominations. Loot, level up, strategize, fight, die and wake up anew. Unlock the secrets of the Loot River. Immortality is a bittersweet gift.<br/>Unleash your creativity with a level editor – design, share, and play unique levels crafted by you and the community!<br/>

LONG
*** Online Functionality will be discontinued from the end of March 2021 ***<br/><br/>Explore an outlandish outer space, gather Loot Cards, and fight your way to The Thing Below in this innovative and offbeat strategy roguelike.<br/><br/>Beat up strange baddies and win Loot Cards which give you special abilities. Choosing which to equip requires strategic thinking - the way you lay them out is crucial, and some must be sacrificed because cards are also the precious resources you need to heal and use powerful abilities.<br/><br/>Careful though because baddies can loot you! The cards they steal drop into other players’ games. When you defeat an Elite Baddie you’ll get another player’s card: will you return it or keep it for yourself?<br/><br/>Either way, prepare for a visit from that player's Holographic Helper to shower you with thanks or terrible vengeance - Loot Rascals is a tale of friendship, loss, and redemption!<br/><br/>Every game is different in this procedurally generated roguelike: gather Loot Cards, show the Thing Below who’s boss, and fly Big Barry to victory!<br/>

Offline play only<br/>1 players<br/>2 network players<br/>DUALSHOCK 4 vibration
